hero.title: Turn Complex Online Selling into Simplicity
hero.subtitlePrefix: With an all-in-one store management platform from

features.title: Receive & Manage All Orders in One Place: Cut Redundancy, Workload & Paperwork
features.description: Accept orders from all sales channels with an intuitive store management system, freeing you to focus entirely on driving sales.

items.title: Smart AI Product Listing
items.description: Just upload an image, and AI crafts compelling product titles and descriptions to close sales instantly <hilight>without typing each one manually.</hilight>

items.title: 0% GP Commission-Free Selling
items.description: Keep 100% of your hard-earned profits. <hilight>No per-item commission cuts like on marketplaces, helping you earn significantly more.</hilight>

items.title: Intelligent Inventory Control
items.description: Accurately oversee stock across all branches in one place, complete with automatic deductions and low-stock alerts <hilight>so you can plan ahead.</hilight>

items.title: Professional Online Storefront
items.description: Create a trustworthy custom store with a smart cart that automatically calculates prices and shipping fees <hilight>to close sales effortlessly.</hilight>

items.title: Centralized Order Management
items.description: Consolidate orders from every channel in one place. Update statuses rapidly <hilight>so you prepare and dispatch packages on time without missing a single order.</hilight>

items.title: In-Depth Sales Analytics
items.description: Review revenue trends and top-selling products through a clear dashboard <hilight>that gives you actionable business visibility in every situation.</hilight>

items.title: Flexible & Direct Payouts
items.description: Customers transfer directly into your account for immediate cash flow with no payout delays, <hilight>coupled with automatic slip verification that speeds up workflows.</hilight>

items.title: Membership & CRM System
items.description: Nurture loyal customers with reward points and tailored promotions <hilight>that drive repeat purchases and build sustainable revenue.</hilight>

items.title: Sales-Boosting Coupons & Promos
items.description: Create discount codes, flash sales, or Buy-1-Get-1 deals as you wish <hilight>to encourage faster customer purchasing decisions.</hilight>

items.title: Rapid Product Import & Export
items.description: Migrate large product catalogs from Lazada or Shopee quickly via CSV/JSON files, <hilight>launching or updating your store in minutes.</hilight>

items.title: Complete Logistics Management
items.description: Manage shipment statuses professionally, enter tracking numbers, and send automated notifications directly to customers <hilight>reducing status inquiries.</hilight>

items.title: Shipping Label Printing System
items.description: Generate shipping labels with complete order details instantly. Compatible with thermal printers <hilight>to eliminate handwriting and fulfillment errors.</hilight>

productTypes.title: Supports Every Business Model, Whatever You Sell
productTypes.description: Designed for maximum flexibility—supporting both physical store inventory and all digital product formats without switching between different systems.

items.title: Physical Goods
items.description: Manage tangible inventory with <hilight>accurate multi-branch warehouse tracking and standard shipping workflows you fully control.</hilight>

items.title: Digital Items & Keys
items.description: Sell top-up cards, game keys, or software licenses with <hilight>automatic randomized key dispatch and instant usage status verification.</hilight>

items.title: Digital Download Links
items.description: Deliver digital content via private download links with heightened security through <hilight>granular access control for files and courses.</hilight>

items.title: Digital Services & Top-ups
items.description: Connect directly to your backend logic via Webhooks, ideal for <hilight>commissioned work, ranking boosts, or custom API-driven services.</hilight>

pos.title: Effortless Counter Sales with Built-in POS
pos.description: Whether you operate a physical storefront or a pickup point, our POS connects directly to your online inventory, automatically deducting stock and eliminating count discrepancies.

items.title: Point-of-Sale Support
items.description: Turn your device into a smart cashier system supporting barcode scanning and <hilight>real-time warehouse stock deductions on every sale.</hilight>

items.title: Comprehensive Payment Options
items.description: Accept both cash and QR code transfers with <hilight>automated payment slip verification to eliminate human error and fraud.</hilight>

items.title: Smart Sales Insights
items.description: Access real-time daily sales summaries and <hilight>best-selling product analytics to optimize your purchasing and inventory decisions.</hilight>

items.title: Instant Receipt Printing
items.description: Connect seamlessly with thermal printers to issue professional customer receipts on the spot, <hilight>enhancing your store's credibility.</hilight>

items.title: Customer Profile Tracking
items.description: Log customer purchase history at checkout to build loyalty programs that <hilight>retain regulars and encourage recurring visits.</hilight>

inventory.title: Seamless Inventory Control & Inter-Branch Stock Transfers
inventory.description: Multi-branch warehouse management: check branch inventory, transfer items seamlessly, and log stock adjustments for damaged or expired goods.

items.title: Branch-Specific Inventory Management
items.description: Check item stock and set minimum stock levels (Min Stock) per branch <hilight>to prevent stockouts across all retail locations.</hilight>

items.title: Inter-Branch Stock Transfer
items.description: Submit transfer requests and record movements from one branch to another, <hilight>tracking inventory in transit in real time.</hilight>

items.title: Reason-Based Stock Adjustments
items.description: Record inventory adjustments with explicit reasons like Damaged, Lost, or Expired <hilight>to pinpoint loss and control costs.</hilight>

items.title: Low Stock Alerts
items.description: Receive automated notifications when stock drops to threshold levels, <hilight>helping you plan replenishment before items run out.</hilight>

items.title: Multi-Branch Architecture
items.description: Manage branch addresses, operating hours, and warehouse-POS associations <hilight>for frictionless multi-location retail.</hilight>

permissions.title: Granular & Secure Employee Permission Management
permissions.description: Decisive access control for your team: segregate permissions by role and branch for safer, organized, and compliant collaboration.

items.title: Granular Permissions
items.description: Precisely control access by domain and action: <hilight>independently configure read, create, edit, delete, approve, or cancel rights.</hilight>

items.title: Role & Branch Allocation
items.description: Assign staff to specific branches they are responsible for, <hilight>restricting data visibility to prevent sensitive leaks.</hilight>

items.title: Pre-Configured Default Roles
items.description: Ready-to-use roles such as Owner, Manager, Cashier, Auditor, and Support <hilight>for immediate and frictionless onboarding.</hilight>

items.title: Custom Individual Permissions
items.description: Flexibly grant or restrict specific rights per employee <hilight>to fit diverse organizational workflows.</hilight>

items.title: Comprehensive Activity Logs
items.description: Audit every administrative action with timestamps and user identifiers <hilight>ensuring full transparency across the board.</hilight>

expenses.title: Track and Manage Store Expenses All in One System
expenses.description: Eliminate bookkeeping chaos: control every store expense, categorize effortlessly, attach receipts, and instantly calculate true net profit.

items.title: Clear Expense Categorization
items.description: Categorize expenses into rent, utilities, payroll, or marketing <hilight>for precise operational cost analysis.</hilight>

items.title: Receipt & Slip Attachments
items.description: Upload photos of receipts and proof of payment directly to the system <hilight>for transparent and hassle-free audits.</hilight>

items.title: Branch-Specific Expenses
items.description: Attribute costs to the exact branch where they occurred, <hilight>ensuring accurate net profit calculations per location.</hilight>

items.title: Real-Time Income & Expense Reports
items.description: Correlate sales and overhead instantaneously <hilight>to see true net profit and make confident financial decisions.</hilight>

items.title: Detailed Notes & Date Tracking
items.description: Record transaction dates alongside explanatory notes <hilight>to monitor long-term spending patterns.</hilight>

reseller.title: Scale Your Business with Built-in Reseller & B2B Tools
reseller.description: Professionally manage reseller networks and wholesale pricing: digital agreements, custom tier rates, and centralized bulk inventory deduction.

items.title: Reseller Agreements
items.description: Form agreements and approve reseller authorizations for both internal platform merchants and external agents <hilight>in a unified workflow.</hilight>

items.title: Custom Wholesale Pricing
items.description: Set tier discounts or specialized wholesale prices down to the variant level <hilight>to match multi-tier agent structures.</hilight>

items.title: Multi-Type Agent Support
items.description: Accommodate both connected internal stores and external agency orders, <hilight>expanding your distribution channels without limits.</hilight>

items.title: Wholesale Order Tracking
items.description: Link reseller purchase orders to your warehouse stock, <hilight>accurately tracking margins and aggregate agent volume.</hilight>

items.title: Contract Lifecycle Management
items.description: Govern contract states (Pending, Active, Terminated) with start dates <hilight>for clear, compliant trade partnerships.</hilight>

customerLoyalty.title: Retain Customers with Loyalty Points & Turn Reviews into Revenue
customerLoyalty.description: Build a loyal customer base with memberships, reward points, dynamic coupons, and smart reward incentives for photo/video product reviews.

items.title: Reward Points on Purchases
items.description: Customers earn points on every order to redeem as discounts on their next purchase, <hilight>effectively driving repeat conversions.</hilight>

items.title: Review-for-Points Incentives
items.description: Award bonus points when customers submit detailed reviews with photos or videos, <hilight>boosting authentic social proof.</hilight>

items.title: Dynamic Promo Codes & Coupons
items.description: Issue percentage or fixed-amount discount codes, enforce minimum spends, and set per-user usage limits flexibly.

items.title: Customer Segmentation & Merchant Notes
items.description: Track lifetime spend, apply custom customer tags, and log personal merchant notes to deliver attentive VIP care.

items.title: Branch-Specific Promotions
items.description: Tie reward coupons and points campaigns to specific branches <hilight>to drive targeted local foot traffic.</hilight>

storeCustomization.title: Build a Storefront in Your Unique Style
storeCustomization.description: Every square inch of your storefront reflects your brand identity—customize colors, banners, videos, and layouts to stand out from the crowd.

items.title: Custom Brand Colors
items.description: Establish a distinctive brand presence by matching store color schemes to your identity, <hilight>creating immediate customer recognition.</hilight>

items.title: Image & Video Media Support
items.description: Showcase high-resolution promotional imagery and videos up to 10MB per file <hilight>to convey product highlights vividly.</hilight>

items.title: Header & Navbar Customization
items.description: Freely adjust navigation bars and hero layouts, giving your digital store <hilight>a professional, intuitive layout.</hilight>

items.title: Category Image Showcases
items.description: Assign vibrant cover photos to each product collection to guide visitors and <hilight>enhance the aesthetic appeal of your store.</hilight>

payments.title: Fast Payouts Directly to Your Account via QR PromptPay & Bank Transfer
payments.description: Start selling immediately with zero waiting! Funds go straight to your bank account with no middleman, backed by automated slip verification.

items.title: Direct Bank Account Deposits
items.description: Ultimate financial freedom! Customer payments <hilight>arrive in your account immediately without marketplace payout holding periods.</hilight>

items.title: Automated Slip Verification
items.description: Verify bank transfer QR slips instantly. <hilight>Detect forged slips and mismatching amounts so you can fulfill orders even while asleep.</hilight>

items.title: PromptPay & All Thai Banks
items.description: Generate exact payment QR codes for effortless mobile banking checkout, <hilight>accelerating order completion.</hilight>

items.title: International Credit Card Support
items.description: As your business expands, connect Stripe to <hilight>accept major credit/debit cards and installment plans</hilight> (subject to provider verification).

items.title: 0% GP Commission Cost Savings
items.description: Keep full profit margins because <hilight>we never take a cut of your sales revenue,</hilight> ensuring healthier operating cash flow.

items.title: Agile Business Cash Flow
items.description: With direct bank receipts, you can <hilight>reinvest funds or purchase inventory immediately without waiting for billing cycles.</hilight>

aiVerification.title: Automate with AI: Fraud-Proof Slip Check & 24/7 Chat Assistant
aiVerification.description: Cut admin workload and maximize security with AI-driven slip verification that detects fraud, plus an AI chatbot assisting customers around the clock.

items.title: AI Payment Slip Verification
items.description: Verify slip validity, transferred amounts, and recipient details the moment customers upload, <hilight>blocking forged and duplicate slips 100%.</hilight>

items.title: Slip Verification Audit History
items.description: Retain a comprehensive log of every scanned slip and detect repeat fraudsters to trigger alerts or ban bad actors.

items.title: 24/7 AI Customer Assistant
items.description: Enable AI assistants inside chat threads to answer queries, supply product specs, and assist buyers 24/7 <hilight>closing sales while you are away.</hilight>

items.title: Unified Conversation Inbox
items.description: Centralize all buyer messages—both support inquiries and storefront purchase queries—so your team can manage threads efficiently.

items.title: Real-Time Fast Processing
items.description: Confirm balances and respond to shoppers within seconds, <hilight>massively reducing administrative response delays.</hilight>

chat.title: Seamless Customer Engagement with Built-in Live Chat
chat.description: Manage customer conversations for sales and post-purchase support. Collaborate with team members and let AI assist customers 24/7.

items.title: Centralized Chat Inbox
items.description: Consolidate shopper communications across sales and post-purchase care in one place, <hilight>so your team never misses an inquiry.</hilight>

items.title: Clear Conversation Categorization
items.description: Segment chats by intent (Store vs. Support) to route cases accurately, <hilight>improving customer issue resolution speed.</hilight>

items.title: 24/7 AI Smart Responder
items.description: Toggle AI assistants per chat to answer inquiries, share product catalogs, <hilight>and secure sales around the clock.</hilight>

items.title: Multi-Agent Team Collaboration
items.description: Assign multiple staff members to join the same thread, <hilight>backed by per-agent unread message tracking.</hilight>

items.title: Rich Media & System Messages
items.description: Seamlessly send product photos, transfer slips, and automated order alerts <hilight>for clear, professional buyer communication.</hilight>

logistics.title: Effortless Logistics with End-to-End Automation
logistics.description: Connect with leading courier partners: manage orders, calculate shipping rates, and notify tracking numbers in one place. Save over 50% of packing time.

items.title: Big Data Shipping Matrix
items.description: Apply standard shipping rate matrices calculated from real-world regional delivery data <hilight>so you price shipping fairly without absorbing losses.</hilight>

items.title: Flexible Shipping Rules
items.description: Configure rates by weight, piece count, or offer free delivery on qualifying order amounts <hilight>to accurately manage logistics costs.</hilight>

items.title: All Major Couriers Supported
items.description: Whether shipping with Flash, J&T, Thailand Post, or local couriers, <hilight>manage all fulfillments inside a single platform.</hilight>

items.title: Standard Shipping Label Printing
items.description: Generate clean labels with recipient addresses and embedded packing lists <hilight>for rapid, error-free packaging.</hilight>

items.title: Tracking Number Management
items.description: Publish tracking numbers to customer order portals automatically, <hilight>complete with historical dispatch tracking logs.</hilight>

items.title: Shipment Status Workflow
items.description: Transition orders from "Preparing" to "Shipped" smoothly, <hilight>giving your entire fulfillment team complete operational clarity.</hilight>

items.title: Customer Parcel Tracking Portal
items.description: Customers check parcel tracking directly on your store's website, <hilight>drastically reducing status inquiry messages.</hilight>

infrastructure.title: Enterprise-Grade Infrastructure You Can Rely On
infrastructure.description: Sitepow runs on an infrastructure engineered specifically for commerce: powered by high-performance AMD EPYC™ CPUs and modern cloud-native architecture, ensuring your store is always ready for high traffic.

items.title: Redis Distributed Caching
items.description: Redis caches frequently queried data to offload primary database reads, <hilight>delivering near-instant page loads for your visitors.</hilight>

items.title: AMD EPYC™ Enterprise Processors
items.description: Every store is powered by enterprise-grade AMD EPYC™ CPUs hosted at top-tier Thai data center ReadyIDC, <hilight>reliably handling heavy traffic surges.</hilight>

items.title: Next.js App Router
items.description: Constructed with the modern Next.js App Router featuring Server Components and Streaming <hilight>for faster load times than competitors.</hilight>

items.title: PostgreSQL & Prisma ORM
items.description: Core data is secured within PostgreSQL via Prisma ORM supporting complex transactions <hilight>for 100% integrity of products and orders.</hilight>

items.title: Multi-Tenant Architecture
items.description: Each store is partitioned into a secure, distinct namespace, <hilight>concurrently powering tens of thousands of storefronts.</hilight>

items.title: Enterprise SSL & Security
items.description: Automated SSL certificates encrypt all communications end-to-end, <hilight>shielding customer information against unauthorized interception.</hilight>

items.title: Domestic Data Center in Thailand
items.description: Local servers offer sub-10ms latency for domestic shoppers, <hilight>ensuring snappy storefront experiences across all devices.</hilight>

securityTrust.title: Safer and More Reliable: Never Risk Your Business with Pirated Software
securityTrust.description: We eliminate the risks of cracked plugins and vulnerable software with a secure, verified cloud SaaS built to protect your business.

items.title: Cloud-Native Protection
items.description: Your business data lives in encrypted servers adhering to <hilight>bank-level security standards, completely preventing unauthorized access.</hilight>

items.title: Real-Time Vulnerability Patches
items.description: No manual patching required—our platform rolls out security updates <hilight>continuously, closing attack vectors before exploits occur.</hilight>

items.title: Immune to Cracked Code Exploits
items.description: With pure SaaS architecture, all core business logic is safeguarded server-side, <hilight>making unauthorized tampering or reverse engineering impossible.</hilight>

items.title: Customer Privacy Protection
items.description: We enforce rigorous privacy protocols and transparent audit logs, <hilight>free from spyware or backdoors prevalent in pirated tools.</hilight>

items.title: Automated Redundant Backups
items.description: Never fear data loss—instant backups capture your business records as orders transition, <hilight>storing redundant copies across multiple data centers.</hilight>

items.title: Individual Access Governance
items.description: Grant granular staff permissions on what records they can view or modify <hilight>all managed centrally from your control panel.</hilight>

items.title: Proactive Threat Detection
items.description: Automated behavioral monitors detect anomalous activity: <hilight>suspicious login attempts or abnormal queries prompt instant security alerts.</hilight>

items.title: Consistent Cloud Performance
items.description: Never worry about hardware limitations—cloud processing ensures <hilight>your store runs at peak responsiveness from any device.</hilight>

pricingPhilosophy.title: Pricing Built for Merchants: We Grow as You Grow
pricingPhilosophy.description: As developers, we know starting out is tough. We designed our pricing so you can breathe easily without recurring overhead when you're just getting started.

items.title: One-Time Setup Fee
items.description: Subscribe for the first month so we can configure everything for you to sell immediately <hilight>without large upfront capital requirements.</hilight>

items.title: Sales-Aligned Billing
items.description: Whenever your store generates sales, standard package rates apply <hilight>ensuring your business cash flow always stays resilient.</hilight>

items.title: No Sales, No Fees
items.description: If your store records zero sales in a period, rental charges halt and renew automatically <hilight>giving you breathing room without fixed overhead.</hilight>

items.title: Exceptional Value on Annual Plans
items.description: Select annual subscriptions to lock in discount pricing and <hilight>guarantee 12 months of uninterrupted service without monthly sales worries.</hilight>

items.title: Plans That Adapt with You
items.description: We adapt plans to fit your growth: <hilight>as sales expand, the system recommends tier upgrades for maximum cost-efficiency.</hilight>

items.title: Ready to Scale With Your Growth
items.description: When your business takes off, we unlock enterprise capabilities instantly <hilight>ensuring your storefront effortlessly handles heavy buyer traffic.</hilight>
